implementation.name: Space Race (Analogue Pocket, ericlewis)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 52 HDL source files (41 systemverilog, 11 verilog). There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machines unmapped: Atari's 1973 Space Race has no machine in MAME 0.288 (the TTL driver set does not cover it), so the core's own MRA-less ROM recipe has nothing to join to. license_id omitted: the repository has no LICENSE, LICENCE or COPYING file at its root and no licence grant was found in the HDL headers read (src/fpga/apf/apf_top.v, src/fpga/apf/common.v, src/fpga/apf/io_bridge_peripheral.v). hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 52 source files (41 systemverilog, 11 verilog), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify. Core identity read from the openFPGA manifest dist/Cores/ericlewis.SpaceRace/core.json in the repository, which declares core identifier ericlewis.SpaceRace.
